## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and the system that owns it.

## Verification

- [ ] I tested the affected behavior in a real browser.
- [ ] I checked desktop and mobile behavior when the change affects UI or controls.
- [ ] I added or updated focused tests where they reduce regression risk.
- [ ] I documented data, model, media, font, and code provenance for new material.
- [ ] I verified that no secret, production credential, or real user data is included.
- [ ] My commits include a Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] No new file exceeds 700 lines without a documented reason.

## Data And Compatibility

Describe migrations, provider terms, attribution changes, and compatibility with
existing user data. Write `None` when not applicable.
